rules.quote: Include keywords in URLs, metadata and content.
rules.specification: The page identifies three locations for keywords but does not specify a required keyword set, keyword frequency or which metadata fields must contain keywords.
rules.violation_condition: A web page’s URL, metadata or content lacks keywords reflecting the page’s core ideas and topics.
rules.why: G-2 keeps the locations together as cases of the same missing-keyword check.

rules.specification: This text-checking item concerns accessible link wording. The page does not define accessibility criteria; technical or visual link accessibility is outside this item.
rules.violation_condition: A link has wording that is inaccessible to users.
rules.why: The one-finding test separates link accessibility from the quality of the linked content.

rules.quote: Create accessible links to high-quality content.
rules.specification: This item concerns the quality of linked content, not link accessibility. The page supplies no quality criteria, and assessment requires access to the destination content.
rules.violation_condition: A link points to content that is not high quality.
when: When the web page includes links to other content.
rules.why: The one-finding test separates destination quality from link accessibility.
